name: Hardcoded credential
message: Read credentials from the environment or a secret manager, never from a literal.

name: Interpolated SQL
message: Pass query arguments as parameters; Sprintf into SQL is an injection.

name: Panic in library code
message: Return an error and let the caller decide; a panic takes the whole process down.

name: Discarded context
message: Propagate the caller's context so cancellation and deadlines survive the call.

name: Secret material committed by path
message: Environment files and key material belong in a secret manager, never in Git. Remove it from the index and rotate the credential.
